{{Quote|My name is Spraug. It means fearless.''"<br />"''You're ''shaking'', Spraug.''"<br />"''It's just a name.|Spraug and Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="Invasion 5">[[Invasion 5|''Invasion'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Spraug''' was a [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] low-scale criminal living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. He had in his possession a [[Dray's holocron|holocron]] with [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Finn Galfridian]] tracked him down and confronted him with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Anakin Solo]], and [[Lowbacca]]. Spraug tried to flee the group but Lowbacca stopped him by kicking him. He then introduced himself and Leia made him sell his holocron for nowhere near what it was worth.

Spraug was later seen in the company of [[Dahal]] and [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]]. Dray sensed that Finn Galfridian was returning to Nar Shaddaa, and had Dahal and Spraug buy him new clothes.
